description: One Slack app per agent. Create the app at api.slack.com/apps with Socket Mode enabled, install it to your workspace, and paste its two tokens here.

appToken.title: App-level token (xapp-...)
appToken.description: Basic Information → App-Level Tokens → generate a token with the connections:write scope. Stored encrypted; never shown again.

botToken.title: Bot token (xoxb-...)
botToken.description: OAuth & Permissions → Bot User OAuth Token, available once the app is installed to the workspace. Stored encrypted; never shown again.

threadReplies.title: Always reply in a thread
threadReplies.description: Answer a top-level message in a thread on that message; each thread is its own conversation. Off: answer in the channel or DM itself, one conversation per channel.

respondDM.title: Answer direct messages
respondDM.description: Answer every message sent to the bot in a direct message.

respondMention.title: Answer @mentions in channels
respondMention.description: Answer when someone @mentions the bot in a channel it is a member of.

respondThread.title: Keep answering in threads
respondThread.description: Once the bot has answered in a thread, answer follow-ups there without a mention, unless the message mentions someone else.
